definitions.content: procedure (other than type approval) which includes the examination and marking and/or issuing of a verification certificate, that ascertains and confirms that the measuring instrument complies with the statutory requirements

procédure (autre que l’approbation de type) qui inclut l’examen et le marquage et/ou la délivrance d’un certificat de vérification et qui constate et confirme que l’instrument de mesure satisfait aux exigences réglementaires
